title: Justin Trudeau to attend Ukraine war anniversary summit
description: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau is to be in Kyiv on Monday along with a dozen other world leaders as Ukraine marks the third anniversary of Russia's invasion of that country.

title: Zelensky offers to step down as president in exchange for peace
description: His offer to step aside follows reports that Ukraine may be forced to hold elections before any final peace deal is signed with Russia. Follow live updates.

title: France, U.K. leaders head to Washington
description: The leaders of France and Britain are making tag-team visits to Washington this week as Europe attempts to persuade U.S. President Donald Trump not to abandon Ukraine in pursuit of a peace deal in the three-year-old war with Russia.
